seoTitle: MCPS Calendar 2026-2027: Start Date, Holidays, Breaks & PDF
seoDescription: View the MCPS 2026-2027 traditional school calendar with first day, last day, holidays, early release days, Winter Break, Spring Break, PDF and ICS download.
calendarNotes: Montgomery County Public Schools starts the 2026-2027 traditional school year on August 25, 2026 and ends on June 11, 2027 with an early release day. Student Transition Day is August 24, 2026. Winter Break includes holidays, non-instructional days, and systemwide closures from December 23, 2026 through January 2, 2027. Spring Break includes holidays and systemwide closures from March 31 through April 2, 2027. The adopted calendar lists 181 instructional days, marking period end dates, early release days, grading and planning days, and designated make-up days.

calendarFaqs.q: When does MCPS start school in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: Montgomery County Public Schools starts the 2026-2027 traditional school year for students on Tuesday, August 25, 2026.

calendarFaqs.q: What is MCPS Student Transition Day in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: MCPS Student Transition Day is Monday, August 24, 2026. It is a non-instructional transition and orientation day for students entering selected transition grades and students new to a school, not the regular first day for all students.

calendarFaqs.q: When is MCPS Winter Break in 2026-2027?
calendarFaqs.a: The MCPS calendar groups winter holiday and closure dates around December 23, 2026 through January 2, 2027, with holidays, non-instructional days, and systemwide closures during that period.

calendarFaqs.q: When is MCPS Spring Break in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: The traditional MCPS calendar lists spring closure dates from March 31 through April 2, 2027.

calendarFaqs.q: How many instructional days are in the MCPS 2026-2027 calendar?
calendarFaqs.a: The adopted MCPS 2026-2027 traditional calendar lists 181 instructional days.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the last day of school for MCPS in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: The last day of school for students is Friday, June 11, 2027, and it is listed as an early release day.

customSections.label: MCPS Calendar 2026-2027 At a Glance
customSections.content: Quick reference for the MCPS 2026-2027 traditional school calendar.

customSections.label: MCPS Calendar Important Dates for Families
customSections.content: Families usually check the MCPS calendar first for the first day of school, Student Transition Day, early release dates, non-instructional days, grading and planning days, winter closures, spring closures, designated make-up days, marking period endings, and the last day of school. These dates affect childcare, transportation, work schedules, extracurricular planning, and family travel in Montgomery County.

customSections.label: MCPS Calendar Download Options
customSections.content: Use the MCPS calendar tools to view the official PDF, download a printable PDF, import the ICS calendar into Google Calendar or Apple Calendar, save early release and closure dates, and share school-year dates with family members. Always verify final schedule changes with the official Montgomery County Public Schools calendar source before making critical plans.

customSections.label: Printable MCPS Calendar 2026-2027 PDF
customSections.content: Families looking for a printable MCPS calendar can use the official PDF source or the printable version linked on this page for refrigerator calendars, childcare planning, family travel, and school-year reference. The PDF is useful for printing, but families should still check MCPS updates before relying on it for early release times, make-up days, or school-specific events.

customSections.label: How to Add MCPS Calendar to Google Calendar, Apple Calendar, and Outlook
customSections.content: The MCPS calendar file on MySchoolDates is a one-time ICS download for personal planning. It can help families keep early release dates, holidays, winter closures, spring closures, and the final student day visible in Google Calendar, Apple Calendar, or Outlook.

groups.label: Import steps
items: Download the MCPS 2026-2027 ICS calendar file from this page.
Open Google Calendar and go to Settings, then Import & Export.
Choose the downloaded ICS file and import it into the calendar you use for family planning.
Confirm critical dates against the official MCPS calendar if the district posts revisions.

customSections.label: Planning Around the MCPS Calendar 2026-2027
customSections.content: Families often use the MCPS traditional calendar to plan childcare, transportation, work schedules, appointments, and family travel across Montgomery County and the Washington, D.C. metro area.

groups.label: High-impact planning windows
items: Student Transition Day on August 24, 2026 affects transition grades and students new to a school.
Early release dates before Thanksgiving and Winter Break may require pickup, transportation, or after-school care adjustments.
Winter closure dates run around December 23, 2026 through January 2, 2027.
Spring closure dates run March 31 through April 2, 2027.
The last student day is June 11, 2027 and is listed as an early release day.

groups.label: Dates to verify before booking

customSections.label: MCPS Teacher Workdays, Professional Days, and Early Release Dates Explained
customSections.content: MCPS calendar labels matter because not every date affects students the same way. Teacher preservice days, grading and planning days, professional development dates, early release days, and designated make-up days can each create different family planning needs.
